Class CallInfoProcessor

  • java.lang.Object
    • za.ac.aop.api.CallInfoProcessor

  • public class CallInfoProcessor
extends java.lang.Object
    Manages a collection of Call Information. Provides functionality for storing and retrieving call records captured in the system.
